core_skills.name: content-creation-publisher
core_skills.description: 内容创作与发布全流程技能，整合网页采集、Markdown格式化、智能配图、多平台发布

core_skills.name: video-creation-suite
core_skills.description: 完整的视频创作套件，支持原创创作、视频二创、视频分析三种模式

core_skills.name: NanoBanana-PPT-Skills
core_skills.description: 基于AI自动生成高质量PPT图片和视频，支持智能转场和交互式播放

core_skills.name: tts-voice-synthesis
core_skills.description: 智能语音合成服务，支持音色克隆、拟人化语义适配配音、流式实时生成

core_skills.name: infinitetalk
core_skills.description: 音频驱动的稀疏帧视频配音工具，支持音频驱动的Video-to-Video和Image-to-Video

core_skills.name: antinet-four-color-cards
core_skills.description: 八官署方法论核心分析输出：把解析后的文档与用户意图生成事实蓝卡/解释绿卡/风险黄卡/行动红卡，每张可溯源，面向企业研发知识管理

native-subtitle-quote-image.description_cn: 保留视频内嵌原字幕、精确取帧，拼成 3:4 社交平台长图的 Agent Skill。两级 seek 避开长 GOP 跳帧残影，字幕条零间隙；可 Codex/Claude Code 一句话调用或单独跑 Python，附中/英/韩三语 README 与成品案例。
native-subtitle-quote-image.description_en: Preserves embedded subtitles and extracts precise frames into 3:4 social quote posters. Two-stage seek avoids GOP artifacts; zero-gap captions. Callable from Codex/Claude Code or run standalone Python; ships zh/en/ko READMEs and samples.
native-subtitle-quote-image.author: chengyi-ai

cy-carousel-skill.description_cn: 给选题交回可直接发布的封面 + 10 页竖版轮播 (1440×1920)。带质检流水线：选题比稿→事实核查回论文/史料→只用开放授权素材→手排逐页→渲染→零错误自检→打包，附置顶评论与来源清单。自带 ELIZA、聪明汉斯等样板。
cy-carousel-skill.description_en: Turns a topic into a publish-ready cover + 10 portrait carousel pages (1440×1920). Fact-checked against primary sources, open-license assets only, with QC, packaging and source lists. Ships ELIZA/Smart-Hans sample sets.
cy-carousel-skill.author: chengyi-ai

hairline.title_cn: 跟随鼠标的交互线框图
hairline.description_cn: 33 个等轴测细线图形库 + 两个 Agent Skill（hairline-create 把想法生成单文件无依赖 HTML 线框图；hairline-adopt 把 SVG/Logo 重建为可交互线框）。零运行时依赖、约 35 kB、MIT，React/原生 JS 通用。克制风格：只描边、无填充渐变、图内无文字。
hairline.description_en: 33 isometric line-art figures plus two agent skills (hairline-create: idea→single-file dependency-free HTML wireframe; hairline-adopt: rebuild SVG/logo into interactive wireframe). ~35kB, zero deps, MIT, works in React or vanilla JS.
hairline.author: lucasmarkes

anatomy.title_cn: 把抽象概念造成一台机器
anatomy.description_cn: 先为概念发明物理对应物（缓存命中=弹子锁、令牌桶=带阀水桶、多画布 GPU=龙门绘图仪），再用等轴测相机与零件库逐件造出可交互 SVG/HTML/React。可叠加 WebGL 着色器，悬停爆炸拆解，零 npm 依赖，自带几何审计与 headless 截图自检。
anatomy.description_en: Gives an abstract concept a physical machine analog, then builds interactive SVG/HTML/React with an isometric camera and parts library. WebGL shaders, hover-explode, zero npm deps, built-in geometry audit and headless screenshot self-check.
anatomy.author: wheresryan22

machine-skill.title_cn: 让机器真跑起来的 3D 演示
machine-skill.description_cn: 查真实尺寸原理→程序化 three.js 把机器搭进自包含 HTML，推力/转速/温度/流量由内置物理求解器实时计算（涡扇布雷顿循环、火箭喷管、泵性能曲线）。旋转/剖切/爆炸/X 光/慢放/标注/破坏模式，可录 20–30 秒成片。MIT，教学模型非工程计算。
machine-skill.description_en: Researches real specs, builds machines into a self-contained three.js HTML where thrust/RPM/temp/flow are computed live by an internal physics solver. Rotate/cutaway/explode/X-ray/slow-mo/destroy modes; record 20-30s clips. MIT.
machine-skill.author: AirsupHQ

ancient-rap-battle.title_cn: 古人说唱 Battle 流水线
ancient-rap-battle.description_cn: 把导演活拆成可复跑流水线：文本层挑历史死对头四句一换韵带典故 + Suno API；画面层生图三视图/特写 + 运镜；MiniMax H3 做口型动作对齐 + 史料注释。需 Claude Code + Suno + Midjourney + MiniMax，一期约 $15。
ancient-rap-battle.description_en: Reproducible pipeline for historical-figure rap battles: script layer picks rival pairs with rhymed allusion-laden bars + Suno API; visual layer generates turntable/close-ups + camera moves; MiniMax H3 lip-sync/action alignment + footnotes. ~$15/episode.
ancient-rap-battle.author: 10291124jcjc-dotcom

lemo-opuscar.title_cn: 用代码拍电影的 Opus 风格库
lemo-opuscar.description_cn: 66 套现成风格（art-deco/blueprint/ink-wash/ukiyoe/watercolor 等）+ OPUSCAR 98 奥斯卡特别放映。Canvas/WebGL 逐帧渲染 + 原创配乐 + TTS 旁白，不用视频生成模型/素材库。支持一问一答定制专属风格。Claude Opus 5.5 专用。
lemo-opuscar.description_en: 66 ready styles (art-deco, blueprint, ink-wash, ukiyoe, watercolor…) + OPUSCAR 98 Oscar retrospective. Frame-by-frame Canvas/WebGL rendering with original score + TTS narration—no video-gen models, no stock. Claude Opus 5.5 only.
lemo-opuscar.author: lemomo-ai

awesome-jev.title_cn: Jev 极廉价批量素材筛选
awesome-jev.description_cn: 只做选择题的极廉价分类模型 Jev，把『先读再筛』倒成『先判再读』：不把全文塞上下文就对批次分类，概率近 0.5 的留人工复核。228 个项目按 6 大场景编目，npx skills add 装完让 Agent 找参考实现。
awesome-jev.description_en: Jev is an ultra-cheap multiple-choice triage model—judge before you read. Batch-classify without loading full text; near-0.5 confidence routed to human review. 228 projects cataloged across 6 scenarios.
awesome-jev.author: BeatAPI

RuiC-card-skill.description_cn: 一句话/参考图→画四层图（主体/背景/线稿/文字）→Blender 按景深撑开→镭射材质流光→Three.js 单文件网页。交付网页链接 + card.blend 源工程 + 四层透明 PNG + 配置 + 渲染图 + 验收截图，可拖拽旋转翻面调滑块，四种卡面质感。
RuiC-card-skill.description_en: One sentence or reference image → four-layer art → Blender depth-extrude → iridescent material → single-file Three.js page. Ships web link + card.blend + layered PNGs + config + render + QA; drag-rotate/flip/slider; four finishes.
RuiC-card-skill.author: HRuiCcc

handraw-style.description_cn: 把 261→290 种手绘风格、161 种排版图型、36 种单色主题全部编号化；看图选编号，输出中英双语生图 Prompt。『编号管画风、主题管内容』，同编号可反复换主题；传参考图限定只借线条/笔触/材质/配色。
handraw-style.description_en: Numbered catalog of 261→290 hand-drawn styles, 161 layout motifs, 36 monochrome themes. Pick a number → bilingual image prompt. Same number swaps themes freely; reference images borrow only line/stroke/material/palette.
handraw-style.author: yang0

anything2explainer.title_cn: 任意主题一条出讲解视频
anything2explainer.description_cn: 任意主题/文章→黑幕运动图形讲解视频（1280×720@30fps，词级字幕/章节进度条/顶部 HUD）。研究→旁白→TTS→时间线对齐→故事板→并行 Remotion 构建→QC，4 检查点；每帧代码绘制不用视频模型，中文云希/英文 kokoro 配音，全程留档。
anything2explainer.description_en: Any topic/article → motion-graphics explainer video (1280×720@30fps, word-level captions, chapter bar, top HUD). Research→narration→TTS→timeline→storyboard→parallel Remotion build→QC; every frame code-drawn, no video model.
anything2explainer.author: Vincentwei1021

threejs-scroll-worlds.title_cn: 持久 Three.js 滚动世界
threejs-scroll-worlds.description_cn: 一个持久 Three.js 世界 + 归一化可逆滚动状态，相机/光照/材质随章节演化。滚动即叙事时间线，适合产品展示与沉浸式官网首屏。
threejs-scroll-worlds.description_en: A persistent Three.js world with normalized, reversible scroll state; camera/lighting/material evolve per chapter. Scroll is the narrative timeline—ideal for product showcases and immersive landing pages.
threejs-scroll-worlds.author: getedgehq

scrollytelling-web.description_cn: 固定场景、scrub 时间线、产品拆解、渐进式 3D 揭示，按复杂度在 CSS/Motion/GSAP/Three.js 间选最小引擎。轻量滚动叙事方案。
scrollytelling-web.description_en: Fixed scene, scrub timeline, product teardown, progressive 3D reveal—picks the smallest engine (CSS/Motion/GSAP/Three.js) for the complexity. Lightweight scrollytelling.
scrollytelling-web.author: marcmarti9

jack-scroll-3d-sites.title_cn: 滚动 scrub 帧序列 3D 站
jack-scroll-3d-sites.description_cn: 滚动 scrub 视频或帧序列，Apple 风产品展示，建议 40–150 帧。滚动驱动逐帧播放的 3D 产品演示。
jack-scroll-3d-sites.description_en: Scroll-scrubbed video or frame sequence for Apple-style product reveals (40–150 frames suggested). Scroll-driven frame-by-frame 3D product demo.
jack-scroll-3d-sites.author: radustefandumitru
